Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the
intersection in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, but I can give you the details you need.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe how the collision happened?
A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. A vehicle coming from the cross street did not stop and hit
the driver's side of my car.
Q: Had you been to that intersection before?
A: Yes, I drive through it most weekdays, so I know the timing pertty well.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?
A: Yes, I was. The airbags deployed on my side, so it was a hard hit.
Q: Did you feel any injuries rgiht after the collision?
A: My knee hit the dashboard. I felt pain right away, but I thought I could walk it off. By that evening it was swollen and
I could barely bend it.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since then?
A: Yes, I went to uregnt care the next morning and then saw an orthopedic doctor. They ordered an MRI and I'm
currently doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Did you have any knee problems before this collision?
A: No, not that I can recall. I played recreational softball, but I hadn't had any problems with it.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble with stairs and driving for long stretches because of the knee. I'd like to get back to
normal as soon as possible.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
